text:
alex_sales: FYI Lumen Health procurement asked for an assurance bundle for their 3-week POC: redacted SOC2, ISO27001 cert, signed pen-test attestation (they prefer notarized but e-sign is OK), a short network diagram, KMS key handling statement, and confirmation whether external scans are permitted against the POC tenant. Need by next Thursday COB. Any blockers?

nina_security: We can pull SOC2 + ISO PDFs. For the attestation we typically provide a one-paragraph letter + redacted CVSS buckets. Notarization adds ~3 business days; DocuSign is same-day. Also need to confirm scope: POC tenant only?

alex_sales: They said POC tenant only. They also asked whether we can provide a redacted summary of last external pentest rather than the full report.

rick_legal: Legal can sign. I recommend e-sign unless the customer insists on notarization. If notarization is required we need signatory name and jurisdiction and that'll delay delivery. Also we should avoid absolute claims; phrase as "no outstanding critical findings at time of attestation."

zoe_ops: Operational note: allowing external scans requires a signed scan scope form, preapproved IPs, and a maintenance window. If they need an isolated tenant (dedicated slice), provisioning is ~48-72h and there's a cost delta.

nina_security: Suggested attestation text:

"Redwood Inference, Inc. attests that third-party penetration testing is performed at least annually and that scoped assessments of dedicated or staging tenants are available upon request. As of (DATE), there were no outstanding critical vulnerabilities affecting the scoped POC tenant. A redacted summary of the most recent external assessment (counts by CVSS severity) can be provided under NDA."

zoe_ops: Pricing ballpark for short-lived dedicated slice: 1 A10-equivalent for 2 weeks ~= +$3k; setup ops time ~ 3-5 hours. If they request customer-managed KMS for Private that's a separate project.

alex_sales: Action items: (1) Nina draft attestation + redacted CVSS summary and attach SOC2/ISO PDFs, (2) Rick prepare e-sign DocuSign and advise on notarization path if requested, (3) Zoe prepare scan scope form, presigned S3 path for uploads, and pricing delta. Target: send draft pack to procurement by Tue EOD to allow signature time.

infra-bot: TICKET-9999 created: "lumen-health poc assurance packet" assigned to security/legal/ops. Link: https://issues.redwood.internal/TICKET-9999

rick_legal: I'll prep the DocuSign-ready attestation and flag any phrasing that needs tightening. If they want notarization, request signatory details and we'll escalate.

nina_security: Will draft and loop legal. If procurement asks for raw vuln data we'll require NDA and secure upload only.

zoe_ops: I'll post available maintenance windows and provision a placeholder presigned URL when TICKET-9999 is acknowledged.

alex_sales: Thanks team. I'll confirm with procurement whether e-sign is sufficient or notarization is mandatory and update here. :thumbsup:
